name: singlet_deconvolution_bulk_celltype_proportions_sc_reference
title: Bulk cell-type proportions from a single-cell reference
description: Estimates, for each bulk sample, the fraction of each cell type in a labelled multi-donor single-cell or single-nucleus reference, writing obsm/proportions. The default method music needs several donors per cell type; use simplex_ls when the reference has no donor labels, and scaden only when training time is acceptable. Do not use on log-scale input, on single-cell data, or when the reference omits cell types present in the bulk.

dataset.description: Bulk dataset handle (.singlet path or URI) holding raw counts in layers/counts, genes by samples.

reference.description: Single-cell reference: dataset handle and label keys.

dataset.description: Reference dataset handle with raw counts and cell-type labels.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels; undefined and mixed labels must be removed first.

subject_key.description: obs column with donor IDs; required by music and bisque.

min_cells_per_type.description: Drop types with fewer reference cells; 1 keeps every type.

size_correction.description: Convert RNA shares to cell-count fractions using per-type mean library sizes.

method.description: music is the default; simplex_ls is the unweighted heuristic baseline; scaden trains a network.

normalisation.description: cpm library-size normalises bulk and reference; none assumes linear, already normalised input.

marker_genes.description: Optional gene list restricting the regression; null uses all shared genes.

nu.description: Regulariser added to the gene-weight denominator.

eps.description: Convergence threshold on the L1 change in proportions.

use_overlap.description: Learn the bulk transform from donors present in both reference and bulk.

scaden.description: Options for method scaden (training on simulated mixtures).

simulated_samples.description: In-silico bulk samples generated for training.

seed.description: Random seed for scaden training and simulation; other methods are deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing proportions.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the bulk dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/proportions. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, estimand, n_samples, n_cell_types, shared_genes, non_converged_samples, dropped_types.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
